game.title: Naija Whot

game.tagline.text: Match di card, call your shape, make your hand empty first!

game.howto.1.text: Match di top card by shape or by number. Tap one card make e rise, tap am again (or flick am up) to play am. If no card fit, tap di market to pick one.

game.howto.2.text: Whot 20 fit enter anywhere. After you play am, you go call di shape wey you need. Better keep am for last.

game.howto.3.text: 1 Hold On: you go play again. 8 Suspension: di next person miss turn. 14 General Market: everybody else go pick one card, then you go play again.

game.howto.4.text: 2 Pick Two and 5 Pick Three: di next person must pick 2 or 3 cards, except e answer with another 2 or 5 (you fit change dis one for Rules).

game.howto.5.text: When your last card remain one, press Last card. If you forget and CPU catch you, you go pick 2 cards. You fit catch dem too: tap Catch.

game.howto.6.text: Whoever empty im hand first don win. Di computer players dey follow di same rules wey you dey follow.

rules.title: Rules

rules.note.text: Di computer players dey follow di same rules wey you dey follow. Lagos house rules na di default.

rules.stackTwo.help.text: Play 2 for Pick Two and di penalty go add 2 for di next person.

rules.defendFive.help.text: Play 5 for Pick Three and di penalty go add 3 for di next person.

rules.whotOnPending.help.text: Whot 20 fit enter Pick Two or Three and cancel am. E dey off for default.

rules.finishOnSpecial.help.text: You fit finish with any card, even power card. If you off am, your last card no fit be power card, so you must pick card.

rules.marketAgain.help.text: After 14, everybody else go pick one card and you go play again.

rules.lastCard.help.text: Press Last card when one card remain. If you forget and dem catch you, you go pick 2 cards.

rules.semiLast.help.text: Call Semi-last card too when two cards remain. Last card must dey on.

rules.marketEnds.help.text: When market finish, di game go end and di person wey im cards add small pass go win (Whot na 20).

rules.autoDraw.text: Pick card for me when nothing fit

rules.autoDraw.help.text: If you no get card to play, market go pick for you after small time.

rules.fastPlay.help.text: Faster animation and CPU pause for long games.
